justification: The citation proof decides whether a served clause number is the council's. Leichhardt prints its control labels (C1, C2 ...) as pictures, so 146 correct citations in one chapter were refused; and the label check accepted any label printed between the section heading and the rule, so 474 of 517 deliberately shifted labels (C10 stored as C9) passed. Critical: this proof gates approval, and a loose proof serves wrong clause numbers green.

pre_impl.existing_data: No database writes. Read the Leichhardt part-c-s1 PDF: each label is a 52x34 image whose glyph is in its soft mask; the base image is one black box for every label. Page 20 prints C5..C11; the text layer holds a tab there.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Assumed PyMuPDF get_image_rects/get_image_info identify each placed image. They match by base pixels, so every label on a page reported the same image; placements are paired with their image by content-stream draw order instead.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Nothing in scripts/ services/ src/ enrichment/ reads PDF image masks (grep get_images|smask). The probe's private copy of the PDF reader is replaced by citation_proof.read_raw_lines so probe and gate read identically; its line cache key is bumped to v2.
pre_impl.external_source_error: A page whose images are drawn inside form objects gives a draw-order count mismatch and contributes no labels; any mask that would get two names voids picture labels for the whole document. Both fall back to the previous behaviour: the row is refused.
pre_impl.frontend_type: No frontend change. The proof runs in the fidelity gate and the DQ-111 probe only.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A picture named wrongly would prove a wrong citation. Mitigated: names come only from Objectives/Controls runs and must be consistent for every use of the same mask across the document (0 conflicts on 312 Leichhardt placements; 289 named).

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a label printed only as a picture is not read, a mask with two names still names pictures, or a label printed above an EARLIER rule proves this rule
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Corpus probe on the same data: merged checker 4,841 of 15,137 unproven; this branch 4,686. Shift test on Leichhardt part-c-s1: shifted labels proven 474/517 before, 3/517 after (two near-duplicate laneway rules). 32 mutations of the new and changed logic all caught.

functions.name: pdf_picture_labels.name_labels
functions.input: Text lines and label pictures (mask fingerprints) for a whole document, in top-to-bottom page order.
functions.output: (page, y, label) for every picture that can be named from Objectives/Controls runs; [] when any mask would get two names.
functions.if_none: No run heading or no pictures: returns [], so the reading is unchanged and the proof refuses as before.

functions.name: pdf_picture_labels.page_label_pictures
functions.input: An open PyMuPDF document and one page, plus a mask-fingerprint cache shared across pages.
functions.output: (y, x, mask md5) for each image in the left fifth of the page no taller than a text line.
functions.if_none: Unreadable contents or a draw-order count mismatch returns [] for that page.

functions.name: pdf_picture_labels.merge_labels
functions.input: The page's text lines in the PDF's own order and the named pictures.
functions.output: The same lines with each label inserted just before the line on its row (taking that row's y), else before the first line below it.
functions.if_none: No pictures at all: the input list is returned unchanged, same object.

functions.name: citation_proof._own_label
functions.input: Reading lines, the section heading index, and the start and end lines of the whole matched rule.
functions.output: The label whose block holds most of the rule's lines (tie to the later block), else the first label just after the rule.
functions.if_none: No label of the item's shape printed: None, and the row is item_missing or item_format.

values.name: row tolerance
values.why: A label picture's top sits up to 3.2pt below its text line's top; the next line is about 13.8pt down.

values.name: label picture bounds
values.value: right edge within 20% of page width, height at most 16pt
values.why: Leichhardt labels sit at x 72-90 on a 595pt page and are 8pt high; figures are larger or further in.

break_it.scenario: The same label picture is counted as C1 in one section and C3 in another because a Controls heading was missed
break_it.what_happens: Pictures would be given wrong numbers and wrong citations would prove.
break_it.how: Any mask with two names voids picture labels for the whole document.
break_it.repro: python -m pytest tests/test_pdf_picture_labels.py tests/test_pdf_picture_labels_real_pdf.py -k 'two_names or same_picture' -q

break_it.scenario: A citation names the label printed above the PREVIOUS rule (C9 for the C10 rule)
break_it.what_happens: Before this branch it proved: any label between heading and rule counted.
break_it.how: Only the label whose block holds the rule counts.

break_it.scenario: Stored text opens with the rule's sub-heading, printed one line above its label
break_it.what_happens: A last-label-above rule named the previous rule's label.
break_it.how: The label is judged over the whole matched rule, by majority block.

break_it.scenario: Marrickville stores a rule's first line inside its heading, so only line two matches and the next label is nearer
break_it.what_happens: A nearest-label rule named the next rule's label (C15 as C16).
break_it.how: Majority block over the whole match, not distance.

break_it.scenario: A rule's closing words recur in the next rule (Ashfield E2 C53/C54)
break_it.what_happens: A phantom match stretches the span into the next block and the correct C53 is refused.
break_it.how: Known and pinned as a strict xfail: three de-duplication rules each fixed this row and broke 8-15 others on the corpus. The row is refused, the safe direction.

break_it.scenario: Leichhardt draws each page's footer first in its content stream
break_it.what_happens: Labels merged by a running y would all land before the footer at the top of the page.
break_it.how: Each label's position is found per page against its own row.

post_merge.manual_verify: Re-grade the pending Leichhardt review rows so their citation findings reflect the picture labels (dcp_fidelity_gate.py per chapter). 83 served rows newly refused are mostly wrong labels the loose check passed (sampled: stored C13 where C14 is printed; C1 where C13 is printed).
